name: Regulation of interleukin-10/12 and T-cell cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate production of IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21 and TNF-family cytokines and Th1/Treg/activated T-cell responses; IL-12 suppression and IL-10 induction set it apart from the T-cell suppression and inflammatory IL-1 neighbours.

name: Response to heavy metals, dioxin and pesticides
rationale: All members are responses to toxic environmental chemicals (mercury, lead, cobalt, TCDD/AhR, insecticides, herbicides); the heavy-metal ions distinguish it from the bisphenol/fungicide and ethanol neighbours, and dioxin/pesticides from the iron/selenium neighbour.

qualifier: heme B via protoporphyrin with mitochondrial transport
name: Heme B biosynthesis via protoporphyrin and mitochondrial transport
rationale: Members cover protoporphyrinogen IX and heme B synthesis, mitochondrial ABC transporters and positive control of tetrapyrrole/hemoglobin synthesis, lacking the heme A and Fe-S cluster content of neighbours.

qualifier: keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte MITF pigmentation
name: Skin epidermis: keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte pigmentation
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation/cornified envelope and skin barrier plus MITF-M-driven melanocyte pigmentation, combining what the hair/appendage and melanosome-only neighbours each have alone.

name: Glucagon–PKA control of hepatic glycogen and glycolytic flux
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA, AMPK-ChREBP, glucokinase and fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycogen turnover and glycolysis, distinct from gluconeogenesis, glycogen-storage-disease and insulin-signalling neighbours.

name: Gonadotropin secretion and FSH-responsive gonad development
rationale: Members regulate LH/FSH secretion and FSH-dependent Sertoli cell, germ cell, seminiferous tubule and ovarian follicle development, lacking the activin/AMH and GnRH-receptor content of neighbours.

name: Complement activation, regulation and antibody-dependent effector responses
rationale: Members cover classical, lectin and alternative complement activation, the terminal pathway and its regulators plus ADCC and hypersensitivity, distinct from neutrophil, Fc-receptor and antimicrobial-peptide neighbours.

name: Glucagon–PKA and glucokinase control of hepatic glycogen
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA signalling, AMPK-ChREBP, glucokinase regulation and glycogen synthesis/breakdown control, versus gluconeogenesis, triglyceride and G6PC/glycogen-storage-disease neighbours.

name: Organic cation/anion transporter-mediated xenobiotic transport
rationale: Members are organic cation and anion, alpha-ketoglutarate and xenobiotic transmembrane transport including blood-brain barrier export and ciprofloxacin handling, versus SLCO/drug-ADME and polyamine-transport neighbours.

qualifier: IL-1, IL-37 and CD40 receptor signaling
name: Regulation of Toll-like, IL-1 and CD40 receptor signaling
rationale: Members regulate TLR, MyD88, IL-1, IL-37 and CD40 receptor signalling, whereas neighbours carry downstream cytokine production or TRIF/TAK1 events.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signaling and cAMP attenuation
rationale: Members are muscarinic GPCR signalling via Gi and PLC plus cAMP breakdown by Ca/calmodulin PDE1 and dampened cAMP/PKA, versus nicotinic/serotonin and adrenergic neighbours.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and macrophage pathogen responses
rationale: Members centre on NADPH oxidase superoxide generation and respiratory burst in phagocytes plus macrophage responses to pathogens and anti-inflammatory CD163/FCGR3A signalling, which the ROS and neutrophil-killing neighbours lack.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptors with G0 transitions
name: Thyroid/retinoic acid receptor transcription and G0 quiescence transitions
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptor signalling, nuclear receptor transcription/SUMOylation and G0-G1 transitions, distinct from steroid (estrogen/androgen), FOXO and liver neighbours.

name: Cellular iron uptake via transferrin and heme scavenging
rationale: Members cover iron import, transferrin endocytosis, plasma heme scavenging/assimilation and iron transporter defects, versus heme-synthesis, cadmium and copper/manganese neighbours.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte extravasation of neutrophils and T cells
rationale: Members are diapedesis, neutrophil and T-cell extravasation and integrin-mediated leukocyte migration, versus chemokine, adhesion-docking and chemotaxis neighbours.

name: Adrenal gluco- and mineralocorticoid biosynthesis and steroidogenic CYP defects
rationale: Members are pregnenolone, glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis, adrenodoxin electron transfer and CYP11A1/11B1/11B2/17A1/21A2 deficiencies, versus sex-steroid and secretion-regulation neighbours.

name: Megakaryocyte–erythroid lineage differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis, RUNX1 megakaryocyte control and erythroid/megakaryocytic programmes, versus granulocytic progenitor and broad RUNX1 neighbours.

name: Stress hormone–driven behavior: fear, adaptation and ethanol drinking
rationale: Members are behavioural stress responses to CRH and corticosterone including fear, immobilisation stress and drinking/ethanol behaviour, versus HPA hormone-secretion and mating/parental behaviour neighbours.

qualifier: negative regulation of contraction and heart rate
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release and dampening of cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate cardiac SR calcium release, membrane potential, relaxation and negative control of contraction and heart rate, versus positive-inotropy, conduction and skeletal-muscle neighbours.

name: HGF–MET signaling in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
rationale: Members are MET receptor activation and its RAS, PI3K, STAT3, PTPN11, RAP1 effectors plus hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation and liver regeneration, which the TGF-beta, PI3K and PTK6 neighbours lack.

qualifier: EPO, TPO and FLT3 to STAT5
name: EPO, TPO and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin and FLT3 signalling to STAT5, RAS, PI3K and PLCG with CBL negative regulation, versus IL-3/IL-5, FLT3-TKI-resistance and oncogenic RTK-fusion neighbours.

qualifier: intestinal hexose absorption and inherited disorders
name: Glucose, fructose and glycogen metabolism with intestinal hexose absorption
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases, fructose metabolism and dietary sugar digestion and hexose transport, versus pentose/galactose and glucagon-signalling neighbours.

qualifier: salt stress and epithelial salt transport
name: Osmotic and salt stress responses and epithelial salt transport
rationale: Members are hyper/hypo-osmotic and salt stress responses, osmosensing, water homeostasis and renal Na/transepithelial Cl transport, versus cation-chloride cotransporter, potassium and aldosterone neighbours.

name: KIT and PDGFR mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: All members describe KIT or PDGFR mutants binding or resisting TKIs, versus FLT3/ALK resistance and KIT mutant signalling neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial heme biosynthesis and iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members span heme A/B and protoporphyrin synthesis plus Fe-S cluster assembly and TCA enzyme maturation, versus oxidative phosphorylation, iron-uptake and erythrocyte gas-transport neighbours.
